title: STD-6: adopt OpenFeature flags for the goal knobs
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 audit 2026-11-25: `openfeature` is planned in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --check && python3 -c "import json,sys;e=[x for x in json.load(open('seed/standards/standards.json'))['entries'] if x['id']=='openfeature'][0];sys.exit(e['support'] not in ('supported','partial'))"
**Status:** open

OpenFeature flags for the goal knobs. Goal knobs and A/B buckets evaluated through the OpenFeature API instead of a home-grown knob reader, so any flag provider can serve them.

Lands in `seed/worker/src/goals.js` (and its seed twin so every system inherits it). Move the register entry `openfeature` to supported with `how` paths and a passing test in the same change; replace the home-grown format, do not add a second one.

**Prediction:** standards_supported >= 45 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** adopting a standard nothing in the system reads; a parallel format kept beside the old one.
